subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on 'Your Visit To A Book Fair' in 250 words by answering the following questions.
stimulus: (a) What is a book fair? (b) Which book fair have you visited? (c) What have you found there? (d) How many books have you bought? (e) Do you think a book fair plays a significant role in our life?
